activity_summary: You finished the walk at the garden wall and sat for bread and ale. The three marks were named, and Alse had shown each one to Gillis. It had taken forty minutes. A neighbour said the Mayor might better look to the meal-tubs than the laundry-tubs. Mistress Ansell would not treat the blue-starch precept as law until it was paper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the three names plain and left the precept as talk.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Read a psalm-verse and a prayer for the fruits at the marks, and called the forty minutes done.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Served the short loaf and would not obey a paper she had not got.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Showed the third mark, and said she had shown the first two.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Said the three names back and stopped.
